documentation.cara_kerja: Monitor multi-source data: (1) Shipping port congestion (AIS data), (2) Weather disruptions (NOAA), (3) Geopolitical events (GDELT), (4) Supplier financial health (SEC filings). Aggregate ke unified risk score per supply chain node.
documentation.fungsi: Early warning system untuk supply chain disruptions: Risk Heatmap per region/supplier, Disruption Probability Index, dan Recommended Actions (diversify, stockpile, reroute).
documentation.tujuan: Proactive risk management untuk supply chain managers yang perlu anticipate disruptions sebelum impact ke operations.
